basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old student from Portland, Oregon, currently pursuing a degree in Theology. I have a keen interest in religious studies and enjoy exploring different faiths and their practices. In my free time, I like watching classic Godzilla movies and playing strategy games like Godzilla Battle Line. I recently started taking Zoloft to manage anxiety, and I've been finding support and advice on related subreddits. I'm single and tend to spend my evenings online, mostly between 7 PM and midnight PST. I'm new to Reddit and still exploring different communities.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in religious studies, primarily through my academic coursework. Additionally, I enjoy reading religious texts and participating in online forums to gain diverse perspectives. My interest in mental health has also led me to self-educate on topics related to anxiety and depression, which is how I discovered Zoloft.
